name: 87004 · Bernalillo, NM
findings: ZIP 87004 (Bernalillo) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 87004 (Bernalillo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
